verdict.rationale: Okta documents Admin Management APIs, which its official MCP server wraps for user/group creation, log queries and app listing. It also documents SCIM CRUD for users and groups, outbound event hooks, and positions its developer plan for managing and automating Okta, so substantial programmatic coverage is evidenced. Nothing in the pack claims or demonstrates that the API matches everything available in the admin UI, and probes found no discoverable OpenAPI spec to verify breadth. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI feature parity, a published OpenAPI spec showing full admin surface coverage, independent or hands-on confirmation that UI-only gaps don't exist.
